observations: body L31-L32: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «158,6 a f. (notis non supputatis) pro quos l. quoque.» and «158,5 a f. (notis non supputatis) pro tempore l. partem.»: the sixth and fifth lines from the foot of the text are L31 and L32; the printed «quos» (L31) and «tempore» (L32) are kept.
body L2: the Arabic word is تدل, «they show»; the text layer of the scan does not read it.
body L7, L9: specks stand over the first e of «dimensione» (L7) and over the m of «autem» (L9); they are not accents.
body L30: a dot stands at mid height in the right margin after «Indis»; it is not a sign.
notes_left L9, notes_right L6: the numeral of «Lib. l» and of «t. l» is printed with a small l, its top flagged on the left only, not with the capital I of «VII» (notes_left L8); kept as printed.
body L2, L16: a speck stands under the v of «veni» (L2); the a of «armel-» (L16) is printed blotted.
body L4, L6, L7: the names «Ibn al–A‘lam», «aṣ–Ṣūfī ‘Abd ar–Raḥmān» are letter-spaced as printed; «ibn ‘Omar» is not.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
